en.headline: sogeisetsu: 7 own commits plus 5 automated, 3 issue actions on opencode smoke
en.summary: On 2026-10-19 activity centered on the `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` repository, with **7** own commits plus 5 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The own work reverted temporary acceptance changes, restoring the real model id and the `/oc` login gate, after first probing with a nonexistent account to confirm that a non-owner comment results in skipped. A separate test changed the three-leg model id to an invalid value to force a real failure. Fixes followed: `opencode.yml` could not use `toLower` because GitHub expressions lack that function, and activity event pagination no longer treats an HTTP 422 as fatal, relying on the Link header instead. A new feature added automatic diagnosis when all AI legs fail, plus a manual `/oc` re-check entry point, and the codemap baseline was refreshed to `4719825` after the pagination fix. On the issue side, 3 actions were logged on `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` issue #9, titled `[test] opencode /oc smoke（临时，验完即关）`: it was opened, then commented on later; no issues were closed. A reply came from `github-actions[bot]` on that same issue with the excerpt `pong` linked to a GitHub Actions run, and the thread had 3 comments overall. No pull requests, reviews, releases, discussions, or stars occurred. No section hit its collection cap.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu：本人 7 次提交、自动提交 5 次，opencode 冒烟测试涉 3 个 issue 动作
zh.summary: 2026-10-19 的活动集中在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 仓库，本人提交 **7** 次，另有 5 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。本人工作先是回退临时验收改动，恢复真实 model id 与 `/oc` 的 login 门；此前曾用不存在的账号实测「非本人评论 → skipped」。另一项测试把三条腿的 model id 改成不存在的值，以制造一次真失败。随后修复两处问题：`opencode.yml` 的 if 不能使用 `toLower`（GitHub 表达式没有该函数），活动事件分页不再把 HTTP 422 当致命错误，改为以 Link 头为准。新增功能包括 AI 全失败时自动诊断以及 `/oc` 手动补查入口，并将 codemap 映射基线刷新到 `4719825`。issue 方面，`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 #9（标题「[test] opencode /oc smoke（临时，验完即关）」）记录了 3 个动作：先新开，随后评论，没有关闭。该 issue 收到 `github-actions[bot]` 的一条回复，摘要为 `pong`，附 GitHub Actions 运行链接，整个讨论共 3 条评论。当日没有 pull request、review、release、discussion 或 star 活动。各板块均未触及采集上限。
